name: Bulk recurring invoice actions
description: There are multiple actions that are available including:
whenToUse: Apply a batch action (start, archive, delete) across many recurring invoice ids at once; use for multi-record operations (mutating).

queryParameters.name: index
queryParameters.description:
Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string

ie.

```html
  ?index=new_index
```

response is wrapped

```json
  {
    'new_index' : [
      .....
    ]
  }
```

fields.name: action
fields.description:
The action to be performed, options include:
- `start`
  Starts (or restarts) the recurring invoice. **note** if the recurring invoice has been stopped for a long time, it will attempt to catch back up firing a new Invoice every hour per in
